title: REDI-NET FF-2 Filth Fly Processing
author: REDI-NET Consortium
materials: Flies can be sorted one of three ways:
Select the program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash on the instrument.
Select program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash on the instrument.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Sorting
steps.instruction: Separate flies into groups of biting and non-biting flies based on mouthparts. Identify and sort by genera (e.g., Musca sp.) or species using appropriate morphological keys.

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Store sampled flies at -20 °C for up to 2 months or at -80 °C for long-term storage.

steps.title: Sample Pooling
steps.instruction: Pool flies by mouthpart type, genus, or species. Do not pool flies from different cartons.

steps.title: Workstation and Equipment Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and equipment to prevent contamination.

substeps.instruction: Perform nucleic acid extraction and amplification (PCR) in separate rooms.
Clean work surfaces with RNaseZap, then wipe with 70% molecular biology grade ethanol.
Pre-cool the Bullet Blender by adding dry ice to the cooling compartment and running the cooling program.
Transfer 0.1 mm zirconium oxide beads (two spoons) to Thermo Scientific Screw Cap 1.5 mL Micro Tubes.

steps.title: Reagent Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and suspensions for the IndiMag pathogen kit.

substeps.instruction: For first-time use of the IndiMag pathogen kit: add 100% ethanol to Buffer AW1 and AW2, and 100% Isopropanol to ACB.
If Buffer ATL has precipitates, warm to 56 °C until dissolved.
Prepare buffer ATL-DX: add 100 µL Reagent DX to 15 mL Buffer ATL (or 10 µL Reagent DX to 1.5 mL Buffer ATL in a sterile 2 mL vial). Mix well. Stable for 6 months at 15-25 °C.
Vortex MagAttract Suspension G thoroughly for 3 minutes (first use) or 1 minute (subsequent uses).
Prepare 15 mL or 50 mL conical centrifuge tubes with nuclease-free water for TNA elution in KingFisher Flex or Duo Prime.

steps.title: Homogenization Strategy Selection
steps.instruction: Select a processing strategy for the samples based on the provided guidance figure. The following three methods describe different homogenization paths.

steps.title: Homogenization Method 1 (Two-Step Bead Beating)
steps.instruction: Perform a two-stage homogenization process using orange RINO tubes and bead tubes.

substeps.instruction: Clean forceps with 70% ethanol and Kimwipes.
Label orange RINO® tubes on the caps.
Add flies to tubes and record the number of flies pooled.
Add 400 µL ice cold 1x PBS to each tube.
Load tubes into the cooled Bullet Blender (add more dry ice if necessary).
Run at Speed 10 for 3 minutes. Repeat if flies are not fully homogenized.
Centrifuge samples at 100 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute to pellet debris.
Prepare 1.5 mL tubes containing 0.1 mm ZrO2 beads and 80 µL ATL-DX Lysis Buffer.
Carefully transfer the top 320 µL of homogenate from the orange RINO® tubes into the bead tubes.
Prepare positive control: 37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard Material, 100 µL EBV, 100 µL HIV standard, and 82.5 µL 1x PBS in a bead tube.
Prepare negative control: 320 µL cold sterile 1x PBS in a bead tube.
Load bead tubes into the Bullet Blender (add dry ice if necessary).
Run at Speed 12 for 3 minutes. Let samples settle for 1 minute, then repeat the run.
Centrifuge tubes at 100 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute.
Carefully transfer 350 µL supernatant to a new snap-cap 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. (Stopping point: store at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: Homogenization Method 2 (Direct Bead Beating)
steps.instruction: Perform direct homogenization in clear RINO tubes.

substeps.instruction: Clean forceps with 70% ethanol and Kimwipes.
Label clear RINO® tubes on the caps.
Add flies to tubes and record the number of flies pooled.
Add 320 µL 1x PBS and 80 µL ATL-DX to each tube (master mix may be used).
Prepare positive control (37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS, 100 µL EBV, 100 µL HIV, 82.5 µL 1x PBS) and negative control (320 µL cold sterile 1x PBS) in bead tubes.
Load all bead tubes into the Bullet Blender (add dry ice if necessary).
Run at Speed 12 for 3 minutes. Let samples settle for 1 minute, then repeat the run.
Centrifuge tubes at 100 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute.
Carefully transfer 350 µL supernatant to a new snap-cap 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. (Stopping point: store at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: Homogenization Method 3 (Vortex and Bead Beating)
steps.instruction: Perform initial vortexing followed by bead beating in clear RINO tubes.

substeps.instruction: Clean forceps with 70% ethanol and Kimwipes.
Label 1.5 mL or 2.0 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Add flies to tubes and record the number of flies pooled.
Add 320 µL 1x PBS and 80 µL ATL-DX to each tube (master mix may be used).
Vortex samples on high for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Briefly centrifuge to collect liquid and flies at the bottom.
Transfer the liquid portion (< 400 µL) to prepared clear RINO® tubes containing ZrO2 beads.
Prepare positive control (37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS, 100 µL EBV, 100 µL HIV, 82.5 µL 1x PBS) and negative control (320 µL cold sterile 1x PBS) in bead tubes.
Load all bead tubes into the Bullet Blender (add dry ice if necessary).
Run at Speed 12 for 3 minutes. Let samples settle for 1 minute, then repeat the run.
Centrifuge tubes at 100 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute.
Carefully transfer 350 µL supernatant to a new snap-cap 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. (Stopping point: store at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: TNA Extraction - KingFisher Flex
steps.instruction: Extract total nucleic acids (TNA) using the KingFisher Flex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Confirm use of 96 deep-well magnetic heads and 96 well deep-well heat blocks.
Load the program 'IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash'.
Set up Wash, Elution, and Tip Comb Plates. Do NOT use the kit's elution buffer for TNA elution.
Centrifuge lysate tubes (from step 54) at 12,000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Add 20 µL Proteinase K to wells of a new Deep-well plate.
Transfer 270 µL supernatant (without particle carryover) to the Deep-well plate (Sample Plate).

Prepare a master mix (with 10% overage) of 135 µL Buffer VXL, 540 µL Buffer ACB, and 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G per sample. Mix by slow inversion or Hula mixer for 2 min. Add 695 µL mixture to each sample.
Start the run and load plates when prompted.
After the ~35 minute run, immediately remove the elution plate, cover it, or transfer eluate to final storage tubes.

steps.title: TNA Extraction - KingFisher Duo Prime
steps.instruction: Extract total nucleic acids (TNA) using the KingFisher Duo Prime instrument.

substeps.instruction: Confirm use of 12-tip magnetic head and 12 well deep-well heat blocks.
Load the program 'IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash'.
Set up the Sample Plate and Elution Strip. Do NOT use the kit's elution buffer for TNA elution.
Centrifuge lysate tubes (from step 54) at 12,000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Add 20 µL Proteinase K to wells of a sample row.
Transfer 270 µL supernatant (without particle carryover) to the sample row.

Prepare a master mix (with 10% overage) of 135 µL Buffer VXL, 540 µL Buffer ACB, and 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G per sample. Mix by slow inversion or Hula mixer for 2 min. Add 695 µL mixture to each sample.
Start the run and load the plate/strip when prompted. Keep the door open during extraction to prevent ethanol vapor buildup.
After the ~35 minute run, immediately remove the elution strip and transfer eluate to final storage tubes.

steps.title: Quantification and Storage
steps.instruction: Measure TNA concentration and store samples.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 µL of TNA for DNA and RNA concentration measurement using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer with Qubit 1X dsDNA HS Assay Kit and Qubit RNA HS Assay Kit.
Proceed to testing (SOP FF-4) or store at -20 °C for < 2 weeks, or -80 °C for long-term storage (SOP FF-3/FF-4).
